The Race

One line.
Everyone meets it.

Four of you, one clock, nowhere to hide. Run, bike, row, ski — then a flat-out sprint for the line. Somewhere in the burn you'll hit the redline: the second your body wants to quit. Everyone meets it. The race is what you do next.

01 TEAMS
Teams of four

Two women, two men — all four race as one. Your clock stops when the last of you crosses the line. That time is your score.

02 THE WORKOUT
Run, bike, row, ski

Three parts — bike, row, ski. Each is a run, a machine, a run, then the machine again at half. Run together, split the machines, sprint to finish.

03 CATEGORIES & TICKETS
Category + ticket type

Everyday or Elite — same format, scaled load. Race once, or take the Season Pass for all five.

Find your limit.
Then cross it.

Ready to find your line?

The Workout

Run. Bike. Row.
Ski. Relay.

Teams of four — two men, two women. Every part is the same shape: a 200m team run, a machine, another 200m run, then half the machine. All four run together every time, and each machine's total distance is split across the team however you want. Only the Part 1 runs carry a dead ball — the rest are clean 200m runs. Three parts — bike, row, ski — then a final 200m sprint to the line. Everyday or Elite: same format, scaled load.

The Why

Why we built
REDLN.

Most training never asks the real question. REDLN does: what happens when you reach the point you'd normally stop — and keep going anyway?

Mission

Make the limit visible

We turn an abstract feeling — redlining — into a measured, repeatable event. You can't improve what you can't see. We show you the line so you can move it.

Value 01

Effort over ego

Weights scale, the clock is honest. A first-timer and a national athlete run the same format and both leave having met their own line.

Value 02

Together at the edge

Nobody redlines alone here. The room gets loud where it gets hard. The community is the point, the race is the excuse.

Value 03

Progress, on the record

Every race is timed and logged. Progress isn't a feeling — it's a faster line than last time, in front of everyone. Come back and chase it.

Value 04

Built in Dubai

Born in the city that turned its own name into a verb — to Dubai-it is to do the extraordinary, with excellence, in record time. That's exactly what we ask of you at the line. Homegrown, not franchised — and proud of it.

Promise

You'll surprise yourself

Everyone underestimates their line. Everyone. The best part of every race is the face people make when they cross theirs.

FAQ

Before you race

The things people ask most. Still stuck? The contact page has a human on the other end.

Who can participate?

+
REDLN. is open to all athletes and fitness enthusiasts aged 18 and above.

Are there categories or divisions for different skill levels?

+
Yes — there's an Everyday and an Elite category, so there's something to suit all. There are no skilled movements in the competition; it's all erg based. Please choose the category that best fits your level!

Are spectators allowed?

+
Absolutely! Spectators of all ages are welcome to watch and support the athletes taking part at REDLN.

Will hydration be provided?

+
Yes, hydration will be provided for all participating athletes.

What is the scoring criteria?

+
The competition is scored based on the time it takes you to complete the workout.

Are there partners involved in REDLN.?

+
Yes! Partners from fitness, recovery, hydration and food will be present on the day.

What happens if I can't attend after registering?

+
Registration fees are non-refundable, but transfers may be allowed up to one week prior to the event.

Where is the event located?

+
REDLN. is hosted at Ballers Dubai (outdoor football courts). You can find the venue here: Ballers Dubai.

Is there parking available?

+
Yes — there's parking at Ballers Dubai and the surrounding area, plus parking at Dubai Mall, a short walk from the venue.

Who can I contact for more information?

+
For inquiries, partnerships, or sponsorships, contact:
E: hello@redln.ae
M: +971 50 123 4567
